shortlist.label: Discoid lupus erythematosus
shortlist.why_kept: Patient's history of lupus nephritis and presence of scaly, crusted pink plaques on physical examination

shortlist.label: Cutaneous lupus erythematosus
shortlist.why_kept: Patient's history of lupus nephritis and biopsy results showing vacuolar interface dermatitis

shortlist.label: Subacute cutaneous lupus erythematosus
shortlist.why_kept: Patient's history of lupus nephritis and presence of pruritic and painful periorbital eruption

shortlist.label: Lichen planus
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of scaly, crusted pink plaques on physical examination and follicular involvement on biopsy

shortlist.label: Dermatomyositis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient's history of autoimmune disorders and presence of periorbital eruption with scaly, crusted plaques

raw.rationale: The patient's history of lupus nephritis and the presence of vacuolar interface dermatitis on biopsy, along with follicular involvement and epidermal atrophy, are consistent with cutaneous lupus erythematosus. The periorbital eruption and scaly, crusted pink plaques also support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Discoid lupus erythematosus
rejected.why: While discoid lupus erythematosus can present with similar skin lesions, the patient's systemic history and biopsy results more broadly suggest cutaneous lupus erythematosus.

rejected.label: Subacute cutaneous lupus erythematosus
rejected.why: Subacute cutaneous lupus erythematosus typically presents with more widespread lesions and photosensitivity, which are not mentioned in the vignette.

rejected.label: Lichen planus
rejected.why: Lichen planus can cause pruritic and painful lesions, but the biopsy results showing vacuolar interface dermatitis and the patient's history of lupus nephritis make cutaneous lupus erythematosus a more likely diagnosis.

rejected.label: Dermatomyositis
rejected.why: Dermatomyositis typically presents with muscle weakness and distinct skin findings such as Gottron's papules, which are not described in the vignette.
